hint: Negative $x$ means left of the $y$-axis and negative $y$ means below the $x$-axis. Picture where both are true at once.

hints.text: Negative $x$ means left of the $y$-axis and negative $y$ means below the $x$-axis. Picture where both are true at once.
Left and below is the lower-left region. The quadrants are numbered I, II, III, IV going counter-clockwise from the upper right, so count around to the lower left.
Counting upper right, upper left, lower left gives the third quadrant, so the answer is Quadrant III (choice C).

explanation: The condition $x < 0$ puts a point to the left of the $y$-axis.
The condition $y < 0$ puts a point below the $x$-axis, so together the point is in the lower-left region.
Quadrants are numbered counter-clockwise from the upper right: I upper right, II upper left, III lower left, IV lower right.
The lower-left region is Quadrant III, which is choice C.
